# Trimeverse visual credits

The homepage black-hole loop and its poster are derived from NASA's scientific visualization of a black hole accretion disk by Jeremy Schnittman, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. The video is color styled for Trimeverse and is a prerecorded visualization, not a live feed.

- Visualization: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/13326/
- NASA article: https://www.nasa.gov/universe/nasa-visualization-shows-a-black-holes-warped-world/
- NASA media guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/

The Observe page's Cosmic Cliffs image is credited to NASA, ESA, CSA, and STScI. See the [original image](https://esawebb.org/images/weic2205a/) and [ESA/Webb usage terms](https://esawebb.org/copyright/).

The homepage's planet orbits and hydrogen cloud are schematic teaching illustrations. The sky telemetry is synthetic and labeled as a demo. Simulation equations and model assumptions remain documented within each existing lab.
